model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect of various language families on several models, including mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2. The horizontal axis lists the language families, which are IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indo, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, in that order, with no apparent sorting or ordering. The vertical axis represents the effect, labeled as "effect", with a scale ranging from 0 to 30 in increments of 10, and no units are specified. Each language family has six bars, one for each model, with distinct colors: mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (green), mBERT-B2 (light red), and XLM-B2 (red). Error bars are present for each data point. Approximate values for the bars are as follows: IE-Baltic ranges from 1 to 4; IE-Germanic ranges from 2 to 12; IE-Indo ranges from 10 to 22; IE-Romance ranges from 2 to 8; IE-Slavic ranges from 4 to 16; IE-other ranges from 2 to 10; Isolate ranges from 0 to 2; Semitic ranges from 0 to 15; Uralic ranges from 0 to 2. The bars are not sorted in any specific order within each language family category, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and error bars.
